entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • OpenAPI duplicates a polymorphic union case when the union is used as a property #68653
  • Perf regression: antiforgery-generation, fortunes_ef #68652
  • Perf improvement: json #68651
  • [DirectTLS] run user-callbacks on the threadpool, not on the transport event-pump threads #68647
    11.0-rc2
  • Quarantine VirtualizationTest.ScrollToItem_AfterEndJump_LandsAtTarget #68644
  • Quarantine RoutingTest.NavigationLock_OverlappingNavigationsCancelExistingNavigations_PushState #68642
  • Custom BeforeBuild target's generated wwwroot file missing from staticwebassets.endpoints.json depending on build environment #68641
  • gRPC JsonTranscoding: query string parameter from a `oneof` sibling clears a route-bound field #68639
  • Interactive Server page flickers during navigation in Interactive Auto Blazor app #68637
  • Absolute-form request target with backslash in path is silently normalized by System.Uri instead of being rejected #68636

Closed

  • SignInManager.PasskeySignInAsync throws InvalidOperationException when session challenge has expired instead of returning SignInResult.Failed #67410
    10.0.x
  • SignInManager using ClaimTypes instead of IdentityOptions.ClaimsIdentity where appropriate #26279
    Backlog
  • Improve authenticated check on output caching #68474
  • Pass through response status codes from BadHttpRequestException in ExceptionHandlerMiddleware #43831
    11.0.0
  • Quarantine Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebSockets.Test.WebSocketMiddlewareTests.PingTimeoutCancelsReceiveAsync #65080
  • ApiExplorer does not respect [FromQuery.Name] for complex parameter types #43464
    12.0-preview1
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi fails to generate document when using polymorphic types #58213
    Backlog
  • Allow Blazor components to specify the default render fragment #68623
  • Signal options for unknown passkey credentials #68511
    .NET 12 Planning
  • SignalR should reject duplicate client upload stream IDs instead of replacing active streams #68301
    11.0-rc1
  • Passkey CreatedAt ignores TimeProvider #66477
    12.0-preview1
  • OutputCaching invalid cache keys can coalesce unrelated concurrent responses #67763
